Dribble 2026 — Android project for Google Play
=============================================

This zip is the Android app. Google Play will not accept a build from this chat.
You sign and upload it from Android Studio with a Play Console account.

What's inside
-------------
Dribble-2026-Android/
  android/           ← Gradle project (open this folder in Android Studio)
  store/listing.txt
  store/icons/

On your computer
----------------
1. Unzip this file.

2. Install Android Studio (https://developer.android.com/studio).

3. File → Open → Dribble-2026-Android/android

4. Let Gradle sync. If it asks for an SDK, install API 35 / the prompted version.

5. Build → Generate Signed App Bundle / APK
   - Android App Bundle (.aab) for Play
   - Create a new upload keystore if you do not have one. Keep that keystore.
   - applicationId: com.dribble2026.app
     Change it under android/app/build.gradle if you need an ID you own.

6. In Play Console (https://play.google.com/console):
   - Create app: Dribble 2026
   - Category: Sports game
   - Content rating: everyone / 3+
   - Privacy policy URL: host privacy.html on HTTPS
   - Data safety: no data collected (saves stay on device)
   - Upload the .aab
   - Paste store/listing.txt
   - High-res icon: store/icons/icon-512.png

You cannot skip Android Studio / a keystore. This sandbox cannot sign a Play upload.
